hooks.command: command -v m3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '[m3-memory] m3 CLI not on PATH. Run: pipx install m3-memory && pipx ensurepath, then m3 setup' >&2; exit 1; }; exec m3 hook codex-session-start
hooks.commandWindows: where m3 >nul 2>nul || (echo [m3-memory] m3 CLI not on PATH. Run: pipx install m3-memory, then pipx ensurepath, then m3 setup 1>&2 & exit 1) & m3 hook codex-session-start
